Hi Jane / Mike — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + proposed MAP milestones focused on the legal milestone so we have clear ownership and SLAs: 

Summary of call:
- Scope: Redwood hosted API + Dedicated for data isolation; standard MSA + DPA + SLA to be signed.
- Target close: 2026-03-31 (customer target)
- Key dependencies: ACME legal review of MSA redlines, procurement PO, SOC2 evidence (we shared link in the drive).

Attached: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft) and our baseline MSA with notes (MSA_redlines_20260302.docx).

Proposed MAP legal milestone (please confirm):
1) ACME: return first-pass redlines to Redwood legal — owner: ACME Legal — target: 3 business days
2) Redwood: reconcile redlines, provide tracked-changes and comments — owner: Redwood Legal (Dev Patel) — target: 48 hours after receipt
3) Iteration cadence: each subsequent pass: ACME 2 business days / Redwood 3 business days
4) If material commercial or data clauses are requested (e.g., uptime SLA, data residency), escalate to execs for decision within 2 business days

Ask from ACME: Please confirm who on your side will own edits, the expected turnaround for each pass, and whether the proposed target close date (2026-03-31) still works.

If this looks good I'll update the MAP doc and add explicit milestone owners+dates.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
